A WARM WELCOME TO THE FRESHERS…

At the outset, I would like to express my gratitude to the
concerned authority for having a privilege to serve as the
Principal of Hatichong College that was established in 1988. The
College has an adequate infrastructure to meet up all the
requirements of the student community. It is my pleasure to
welcome you to our esteemed institution, where we strive to
nurture academic excellence and holistic development. We are
committed to provide a conducive learning environment,
innovative teaching methodologies, and opportunities for personal
and professional growth. I hope, the students, the teaching and
non-teaching staff of Hatichong College will comprehend and
appreciate the higher dream of education of Lt. Rameswar Bora and materials his dream by
turning the college into a front ranking degree college of Assam. In this comprehensive
prospectus, you will find detailed information about our undergraduate programs, faculty
expertise, and extracurricular activities. We take pride in our commitment to fostering critical
thinking, creativity, and leadership skills among our students. In the world of Science and
technology, we are vested with the responsibility of moulding today's youth and must ensure
their bright and well secured future.

As you embark on this exciting journey of higher education, I encourage you to explore all that
our college has to offer and envision the possibilities that await you. Whether your aspirations
lie in academia, skill, or entrepreneurship, we are here to support and empower you every step
of the way. I have the full reliance upon the teachers and the employees of our College in leading
the College to come all the dreams true. Lastly on behalf of the entire family of this college, I
would like to welcome each and every student to this glorious institution of knowledge.

I extend my best wishes to you as you consider joining our vibrant academic community.
Together, let us embark on a transformative educational experience that will shape your future
and inspire you to reach new heights of success.

With Regards,



                                                                      Luit Hazarika,

                    THE HISTORICAL BACKGROUND:


Hatichong College, the only educational institute, imparting higher education in the three
Mouzas– Hatichong, Silpukhuri, and Mikirbheta (Morigaon District) was founded on 1st
August 1988 nearby kujidah H.S School in the district of Nagaon, Assam. Hatichong College
is situated at a distance of about 115 KMS from Guwahati, the capital city of Assam and
about 12 KMS from the district Head Quarter Nagaon. As the ultimate consequence of a
general meeting held on the 19th of April 1987 at Kujidah, the institute was set up
temporarily at Kujidah H.S. School (inside) campus with 45 students and 10 teachers in 1988
and shifted to present Bhawan in 1993. The college has now blossomed with an enrolment of
663 students in B.A programme with its own campus of 5.95 Acres of land. The pioneers,
emerging from the mentioned mouzas are to be revealed a note of gratitude on this behalf. It
would be worthwhile to draw attention to a pivotal specialty that the college is pragged with
an effort to fulfill the burning desire for higher education in such a rural region. The healthy
flourishing of the college in such a rural base will surely come to the help of needy students
to achieve their higher goals of learning. Over the years, the college has produced many
illustrious personalities from various walks of life. The College is affiliated to Guwahati
University and registered under 2(F) and 12(B) of the University Grants Commission Act,
1956. Recently ( on 4th and 5th May 2023) Hatichong College has been accredited by NAAC
and graded B++ in its first Cycle with CGPA 2.81. Besides, two certificate courses
(Computer Education and Beautician), the core subjects offered by the college are Assamese,
English, Economics, Political Science, Education, History and Geography having honours
course in Assamese, English, Economics and Political Science. The college developed 3 ICT-
enabled classrooms to meet the present need of the students. There is a central library in the
college having about eleven thousand collections of books and journals. Keeping in tune with
the below vision and mission, the college has been striving to spread quality education to
poor and backward students in all aspects. Besides producing graduates in arts, the college
also aims at identifying and developing the inner talents and qualities of the students of the
rural neighbourhood by providing various pieces of training, Seminars, workshops,
conferences, online programs, coaching, etc.

The 4 year degree course (FYUGP):
The FYUGP is based on a new curricular framework as envisaged under the National Education
Policy 2020 (NEP 2020) by the University Grants Commission (UGC) on the Choice Based
Credit System (CBCS) mode. Basically, the FYUGP is based on the system of education under
liberal arts. The main features of FYUGP are as follows :--

      Duration :
 NEP’s FYUGP is a 4 year bachelor degree program. But it has flexibility for students in
entering and completing the degree, diploma or certificate as he/she likes.

      Exit and entry into the program :--
 In the FYUGP one has the choice to exit from the program thrice---after one year, after two
years and after three years. If one exits the program after one year, he gets a certificate. If one
exits after two years, he gets a diploma. If one exits after three years, he gets a bachelor degree
and finally if a student complete the whole 4 years with major he gets a bachelor degree
(Honours) .

If anybody exits in the middle, the doors will be open for him to enter into the program again and
you can start the journey from where he left.
      Progression/Benefit of the program:---
If a student exit the FYUGP program after 3 years, s/he will need to take admission into the first
year of a 2 years Master’s degree course. On the other hand, if a student fully complete the



FYUGP, s/he may take admission into the 2nd year of a Master degree course and need to
complete only one year to get a Master’s degree.

Semester Details

•      First Year (Semester I & II)

In the first year, one studies three different core subjects – one paper of each subjects per
semester. Besides, one needs to study a host of common subjects that are designed as per
UGC‟s Curricular Framework.

•      Second Year (Semester III & IV)

–      Semester III



In the third semester, one will usually continue with the same core subjects that have
already been chosen in the first year and again study some common subjects. In the third
semester, one will also take a step forward to study the favourite subject by declaring one
of the core subjects as a Major subject and other two as Minors.



However, the structure of the programme remains same as in first & second semesters.

–      Semester IV

From Semester IV onwards, one will primarily study the Major subject by taking at least
four papers, some of which may be elective depending on the subject concerned. same as
the first & second semesters, one will have the option of changing the Major in fourth
semester to any one of the other two Minors as well, even if one has already declared a
Major in the third semester. However this has the condition that the new Major subject of
choice has vacancy.

•      Third Year

In the third year, one will continue to study the Major subject to complete a full set of 15
papers in Majors.

•      Fourth Year

If one intends to progress to the fourth year, s/he will be devoting the time in studying
advanced courses which will be at the level of initial Master‟s degree papers. Besides, one
will also have the opportunity of engaging into research work with the faculty members.

Besides the above, there are some more unique features of the FYUGP. They are
 •     Open Core Credits

From fourth to sixth semester, one will have time for 4 optional open core credits per
semester, which one can utilise to study either of the Major or two Minors. They can also
come handy, if one had changed a Minor subject in between.

•     Double Major

If a student is ready to do some more hard work, s/he can take some extra online courses
(from designated sources only) related to the Minors and can then convert one of the
Minors to a second Major by the time one completes 3 / 4 years of study. This is over and
above the first Major. In this case, one will have a Bachelor‟s Degree with Double Major.

board/ council etc.

Attendance
I.     Minimum 75% attendance in each subject of a student must be required to appear in any end
semester Examination.

II.      Continuous absence for 25 days in a class is enough to debar the concerned students attending
the class or from appearing in the end semester. Examination.

III.    Scholarship holders with less than 75% attendance may be deprived from the scholarship.

College Examinations/Assessments/Tests:
I.      In the present semester system 40% of total marks come from Internal Examination and rest
60 % from end semester evaluation.

II.      The Students must appear the sessional examination conducted by the college. No application
seeking exemption from appearing the sessional examination. However, if any student fails to appear
in the sessional examination, due to some genuine reasons, he/she will duly apply to the head of the
dept. concerned and must appear in the sessional exam within 20 days from the completion of
scheduled dates of each sessional examination.

III.    Nobody will be allowed to appear in the end semester examination without appearing the
sessional examination conducted by the college.If anybody wants to appear in end semester
examination without appearing sessional examination his/her result will not announced by the
university.

    4. SC/ ST/ OBC/ MOBC/ Differently abled/ Tea garden labour scholarships, Govt. of Assam.

    5.   Nirman Shramik Scholarship.

    6. Minority scholarship

    7. Scholarship offered by different individuals/organizations.

Students may claim National Scholarship, state merit scholarship, minority scholarship, (Ishan Udai),
ST/SC/OBC scholarship according to their choice and eligibility. Incentives in case for students who
 are differently able will be awarded. They have to register their name through online in National
Scholarship Portal (NSP). A NSP link also provided in college website also.

         National schemes:
To achieve an all-round development, the College creates opportunities for the students to excel their
hidden talent through social work and other    extension activities. National Service Scheme (NSS),
Red Ribbon Club (RRC), National Cadet Corp (NCC) etc are available in the college.



         Hatichong College Students’ Union (HCSU):
Hatichong College Students’ Union (HCSU) is a democratically elected body of students’
representatives. The body works towards all round development of the students by organizing
different cultural, social, literary activities both in and outside the college campus. It is the platform
for the development of leadership quality of the students. Election for the Students’ Union is held
during the month of September of each academic session.

         Distance Education Study Centre:
A study Centre of Krishna Kanta Handique State Open University (KKHSOU), has been set up at this
college from the session 2023-24. This study centre provides learning opportunities to the
underprivileged learners of this area.

         Educational Tour:
It is privilege for the students to get educational tour provided by the Govt. of Assam.

The college also manages and maintains such type of tour in various times by its own.
